title: emanative
description: A simple modpack for Create and Create Aeronautics!
body:
After the release of Create Aeronautics, I had the urge to put together a quick modpack to share with friends for a vanilla + Create experience! This modpack focuses on Create and Create Aeronautics, with many other essential Create addons, optimization and QOL mods. ## Features: - Create Deco, Copycats+, Rechiseled, Interiors, and more for detailed building and decoration! - Sophisticated Backpacks and Storage Drawers for your storage needs! - Create Jetpack!!! - Structures added by Create: Let The Adventure Begin and Create: Structures Arise! - Create: Enchantment Industry!!! - QOL and optimization mods! - and more!!! I kinda just added all the Create addons ## Full mod list:
